headline: Fire Commission

meeting.summary: The commission heard testimony on firefighter pay and voted to add the issue to next month's agenda; MEMA reported a $9.58 million budget.
meeting.recap: The Fire and Public Safety Commission met on Thursday, July 16, 2026.[[0:00:30]] Commissioners approved the minutes of their previous meeting by roll call vote.[[0:04:22]] MEMA said a roof leak over the computer room is delaying its new emergency operations center.[[0:08:28]] MEMA invited commissioners to a July 24 blessing for the new center.[[0:08:53]] The fire chief said firefighters set up cell service for FEMA more than a dozen times after the Kona low storm.[[0:39:31]] A firefighter presented the department's drone program, which became operational on August 9, 2023.[[1:13:02]] A union representative testified that firefighters take 28 years to reach top pay.[[1:50:36]] He said the department's applicant pool is down 73%.[[1:50:52]] The fire chief said contract talks reached an impasse and went to arbitration, where an outside person decides.[[1:58:53]] The arbitrator's written decision came on April 1.[[2:00:16]] The union representative said the dispute is now in mediation.[[2:13:53]] The commission voted to add the salary issue to next month's agenda.[[2:18:09]] Commissioners were asked to turn in the fire chief's evaluation forms before the next meeting.[[2:20:13]] The next meeting is August 20 at 10 a.m.[[2:20:38]]
decided: The minutes were approved by roll call vote.
The motion passed by roll call vote.
A motion to adjourn was made and seconded, but no vote was heard in the recording.
meeting.next: The chair asked corporation counsel (the County's lawyers) to explain at the next meeting what the commission can and cannot do on the salary issue. The next meeting will include an update on the arbitration process and the testifier's handouts. The evaluation forms will be combined for discussion in an executive session (a closed-door discussion). The drone program is training a firefighter on Lānaʻi and would like to send a drone there.

moments.q: Vote on adding salary items to next agenda
